topic: Unit 11: Wave Motion (Oscillatory Motion, Simple Pendulum T = 2π√(l/g), Transverse & Longitudinal Waves, Wave Equation v = fλ, Ripple Tank Phenomena)
activities: Determine time period of a simple pendulum and verify T ∝ √l; demonstrate wave reflection, refraction, and diffraction in a ripple tank.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 10), STBB Physics X (Unit 10), PhET Wave on a String

topic: Unit 12: Sound (Production & Propagation, Loudness, Pitch, Quality, Intensity, Speed of Sound, Echo Calculations, Ultrasound & Noise Pollution)
activities: Bell-jar experiment showing sound requires a material medium; solve echo distance problems using v = 2d/t; compare oscilloscope waveforms for pitch and loudness.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 11), PhET Sound Waves, Charles Chew (Unit 16)

topic: Unit 13: Geometrical Optics (Reflection, Refraction & Snell's Law, Dispersion, Total Internal Reflection & Optical Fibres, Thin Lenses, Eye Defects & Lensing)
activities: Trace light rays through a glass slab and prism to measure refractive index and critical angle; determine focal length of a convex lens and solve 1/f = 1/p + 1/q.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 12), STBB Physics X (Unit 13), PhET Bending Light & Geometric Optics

topic: Unit 14: Electrostatics (Electric Charge, Gold-Leaf Electroscope, Coulomb's Law, Electrostatic Induction, Electric Field & Potential, Lightning & Applications)
activities: Charge a gold-leaf electroscope by induction and conduction; solve Coulomb's Law F = kq₁q₂/r² and electric field E = F/q numericals.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 13), STBB Physics X (Unit 14), PhET Charges and Fields

topic: Unit 15: Electric Current (Conventional Current, e.m.f. & Potential Difference, Ohm's Law, Ohmic & Non-Ohmic Conductors, Resistivity, Joule's Law, AC & Electrical Safety)
activities: Verify Ohm's Law by plotting I–V characteristics for a metallic resistor and filament lamp; calculate electrical energy in kWh and electricity billing cost.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 14), Charles Chew (Unit 18), PhET Ohm's Law

topic: Unit 16: D.C. Circuits (Series & Parallel Resistor Combinations, Equivalent Resistance, Circuit Diagrams, Rheostat Potential Divider, LDR & Thermistor)
activities: Construct series and parallel resistor circuits using ammeters and voltmeters; measure equivalent resistance and potential divider output.
resources: Charles Chew (Unit 19: DC Circuit), STBB Physics X (Unit 15), PhET Circuit Construction Kit: DC

topic: Unit 17: Magnetism and Electromagnetism (Domain Theory, Magnetic Field Lines, Magnetic Field of Straight Wire & Solenoid, Force on Conductor, Fleming's Left-Hand Rule, DC Motor)
activities: Plot magnetic field lines around bar magnets and current-carrying conductors using a plotting compass; demonstrate Fleming's left-hand rule and DC motor rotation.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 15), STBB Physics X (Unit 16), PhET Magnets and Electromagnets

topic: Unit 18: Electromagnetic Induction (Faraday's Law, Lenz's Law, Fleming's Right-Hand Rule, AC Generator, Mutual Induction, Step-Up/Step-Down Transformers & High-Voltage Transmission)
activities: Demonstrate induced e.m.f. with a magnet, coil, and galvanometer; solve transformer turns-ratio problems N_s/N_p = V_s/V_p and V_pI_p = V_sI_s.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 15), Charles Chew (Unit 23), PhET Faraday's Electromagnetic Lab

topic: Unit 19: Electromagnetic Waves and Electronics (EM Spectrum & Applications, Thermionic Emission, Cathode Ray Oscilloscope, Analogue vs Digital, Logic Gates & Truth Tables)
activities: Construct truth tables and logic circuit diagrams for AND, OR, NOT, NAND, and NOR gates; identify EM wave bands from radio waves to gamma rays.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 16), STBB Physics X (Unit 17), UCAR EM Spectrum Guide

topic: Unit 20: Atomic and Nuclear Physics (Rutherford Scattering, Nuclide Notation, Isotopes, Alpha/Beta/Gamma Decay Equations, Half-Life Calculations, Nuclear Fission & Fusion, Radiation Safety)
activities: Balance nuclear transmutation equations for α, β, and γ decay; plot radioactive decay curves and solve half-life word problems.
resources: Physics 10 PCTB (Unit 18), STBB Physics X (Unit 19), PhET Alpha Decay & Radioactive Dating Game
